rss: Centrica boss says he is 'hugely concerned' over impact of soaring energy bills
title: Electricity Costs Make Things Tricky
story: Electricity bills are getting higher and this makes it harder for families to pay. This means they might not buy as many fun things, like toys or games.
storyBig: With the rise in electricity costs, families are finding it more difficult to manage their budgets, potentially leading to a decrease in spending on discretionary items. This economic pattern can affect various sectors as people prioritize essential expenses.
think: How do you think companies might help families with high electricity bills?
bull: High costs could make companies invent better products.
bear: People might buy fewer fun items if bills are high.

rss: Tinned food and long-life milk boost retail sales after 'Be Ready' campaign launch
title: People Stock Up on Long-Life Food
story: Many people are buying long-lasting foods like cereal and juice. This means cereal and juice companies sell more, but others might sell less.
storyBig: A recent campaign encouraging people to stock up on non-perishable foods has led to an increase in sales for products like cereal and juice. This shift in consumer behavior benefits certain companies while potentially impacting others negatively.
think: Why might people choose to buy long-lasting foods?
bull: Cereal and juice companies are selling lots more!
bear: Other food companies might see less sales.
